sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and an impressive recent run of W-D-W-W-W, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. This is a straightforward fixture on paper: Alsager sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are winless in their last five matches, making Sandbach heavy favorites to extend their excellent form.
divisionWide: The title race remains competitive with second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) also in action away at Dawley Town on Saturday. AFC Bridgnorth (19 points, third) face Eccleshall at home in a match between two strong performers, while fourth-placed Wolverhampton Casuals travel to face Wednesfield Community. Bilston Town (5th) host Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter. Lower down, there are several winnable fixtures: Brereton Social host Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points), while New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town. Cheadle Heath Nomads' visit to Crewe and Barnton's home match against Shawbury United round out the week's ten fixtures, with the latter pairing Shawbury (on a poor run of five consecutive losses) against mid-table Barnton.
